title: The Eid prayer
intro: Two rak‘ahs, twice a year, with six extra takbirs.

learn.html: The Eid prayer is a special prayer prayed twice a year: on the first day of Eid al-Fitr – the 1st of Shawwal – and on the first day of Eid al-Adha – the 10th of Dhul-Hijjah.
The Eid prayer is prayed 45 minutes after sunrise.

The Eid prayer is wajib. It is prayed in jama‘ah, and it is a duty for all adult men. In our communities, after praying Fajr in jama‘ah in the local masjid, the time until the Eid prayer is spent reciting the Qur’an, making duas and listening to advice (wa‘z).

learn.title: How it is prayed
learn.html: The Eid prayer has two rak‘ahs, prayed like the sunnah of Fajr, with six extra takbirs. For each one we say “Allahu akbar” and raise our hands, as in the opening takbir.

items: 1st rak‘ah: Subhanaka, 3 takbirs “Allahu akbar”, A‘udhu, Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah
2nd rak‘ah: Bismillah, Al-Fatiha and a surah, 3 takbirs “Allahu akbar”, then we go into ruku‘

learn.label: Niyyah for the Eid al-Fitr prayer
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ عِيدِ الْفِطْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهَذَا الْإِمَامِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata ‘eedil-fitri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati, iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the prayer of Eid al-Fitr, on time, facing the Qiblah, following this imam. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.label: Niyyah for the Eid al-Adha prayer
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ عِيدِ الْأَضْحَى أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اقْتَدَيْتُ بِهَذَا الْإِمَامِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata ‘eedil-adhaa, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati, iqtadaytu bihaadhal-imaami. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the prayer of Eid al-Adha, on time, facing the Qiblah, following this imam. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.html: After the two rak‘ahs of the Eid prayer, it is sunnah for the imam to give the Eid khutbah.
After the Eid prayer, we traditionally wish each other a happy Eid, and the Eid gathering goes on with family, neighbours and friends.
Practise: Build the Salah – the Fajr sunnah levels; the Eid prayer is prayed the same way, with the extra takbirs.

practice.title: Questions and tasks
prompts: 💬 What is the Eid prayer? Who must pray it? How many rak‘ahs does it have and how are they prayed?
✏️ Task 1: Describe the Islamic customs on the morning of Eid.
🖼️ Task 2: Together, make a poster in maktab that explains how the Eid prayer is prayed.
📅 With your friends in maktab, write a plan of activities for Eid. Share your plans and see if you can help your friends with some of the activities.
